source_title: Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps
claim_supported: Supports a consistent Internet timestamp representation with an explicit relationship to UTC and explains its limited focus on instants rather than intervals.
limitations: Encoding standard only; it does not define timestamp semantics source-clock accuracy effective time decision freshness or facility operating policy.

limitations: Encoding extension only; time-zone metadata does not prove schedule authority accuracy or applicability and receivers may not support every extension.
